Angles are usually written with the `d` suffix for degrees, for example `45d`, while a bare number is read as radians.
Halfling.Geometry.Arc.Width: The angular size of the arc, sweeping from [[Halfling.Geometry.Arc.NearEdge]] in the positive (clockwise) rotation direction to the far edge. A width of `360d` or more makes the arc cover every direction.

Halfling.Geometry.Circle.T:: Stores the center point and radius of a circle in 2-dimensional space.
Halfling.Geometry.Circle.Center: The center point of the circle, written either as a group with `X` and `Y` keys or as a list `[x, y]`. Units and coordinate space come from the field using the circle.
Halfling.Geometry.Circle.Radius: The distance from [[Halfling.Geometry.Circle.Center]] to the circle's edge, in the same units as the center coordinates.

Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.0: The left edge's X position when the whole rectangle is written in list form `[x, y, width, height]`. Vanilla part rules use this form, for example `PhysicalRect = [0, 1, 3, 2]` on the large cannon.
Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.1: The top edge's Y position in the list form `[x, y, width, height]`.
Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.2: The width in the list form `[x, y, width, height]`.
Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.3: The height in the list form `[x, y, width, height]`.
Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.T:: Stores the x, y, width, and height integer values of a rectangle in 2-dimensional space.
Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.X: The horizontal position of the rectangle's left edge, in whole units such as tiles. Together with [[Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Y]], [[Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Width]] and [[Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Height]] it forms the primary group spelling, which the game tries before the edge-based and corner-plus-size spellings.
Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Y: The vertical position of the rectangle's top edge. The Y axis points downward, so the bottom edge sits at Y plus [[Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Height]].
Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Width: The horizontal extent of the rectangle in whole units. The right edge sits at [[Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.X]] plus Width.
Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Height: The vertical extent of the rectangle in whole units. The bottom edge sits at [[Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Y]] plus Height.
Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Left: The position of the left edge in the edge-based spelling. All four of Left, [[Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Right]], [[Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Top]] and [[Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Bottom]] must be given together, as the vanilla `MaxBorders` block in base_ship.rules does. This spelling is only used when the X/Y/Width/Height keys are not all present.
Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Right: The position of the right edge in the edge-based spelling. The game stores it as a width of Right minus [[Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Left]].
Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Top: The position of the top edge in the edge-based spelling. The Y axis points downward, which is why the vanilla `MaxBorders` block uses a negative `Top = -60` for the upper build limit.
Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Bottom: The position of the bottom edge in the edge-based spelling. The game stores it as a height of Bottom minus [[Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Top]].
Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Location: The top-left corner, written as a vector such as `[x, y]`, in the corner-plus-size spelling. Must be paired with [[Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Size]], and this spelling is only used when neither the X/Y/Width/Height nor the Left/Right/Top/Bottom keys are complete.
Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Size: The width and height, written as a vector such as `[w, h]`, in the corner-plus-size spelling. Must be paired with [[Halfling.Geometry.IntRect.Location]].

Halfling.Geometry.IntVector2.0: The X component when the vector is written in list form `[x, y]`.
Halfling.Geometry.IntVector2.1: The Y component when the vector is written in list form `[x, y]`.
Halfling.Geometry.IntVector2.T:: Stores a 2-dimensional point or displacement in space as two integer values.
Halfling.Geometry.IntVector2.X: The whole-number X (1st) component of this IntVector2. Positive X points to the right.
Halfling.Geometry.IntVector2.Y: The whole-number Y (2nd) component of this IntVector2. The Y axis points downward, so positive values are further down.

Halfling.Geometry.Rect.0: The left edge's X position when the whole rectangle is written in list form `[x, y, width, height]`. Vanilla writes most rectangles this way, for example `UVRect = [.5, 0, .5, 1]` in command_move.rules.
Halfling.Geometry.Rect.1: The top edge's Y position in the list form `[x, y, width, height]`.
Halfling.Geometry.Rect.2: The width in the list form `[x, y, width, height]`.
Halfling.Geometry.Rect.3: The height in the list form `[x, y, width, height]`.
Halfling.Geometry.Rect.T:: Stores the x, y, width, and height floating-point values of a rectangle in 2-dimensional space.
Halfling.Geometry.Rect.X: The horizontal position of the rectangle's left edge. Together with [[Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Y]], [[Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Width]] and [[Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Height]] it forms the primary group spelling, which the game tries before the edge-based and corner-plus-size spellings. Units depend on the field using the rectangle.
Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Y: The vertical position of the rectangle's top edge. The Y axis points downward, so the bottom edge sits at Y plus [[Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Height]].
Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Width: The horizontal extent of the rectangle. The right edge sits at [[Halfling.Geometry.Rect.X]] plus Width.
Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Height: The vertical extent of the rectangle. The bottom edge sits at [[Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Y]] plus Height.
Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Left: The position of the left edge in the edge-based spelling. All four of Left, [[Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Right]], [[Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Top]] and [[Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Bottom]] must be given together, and this spelling is only used when the X/Y/Width/Height keys are not all present.
Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Right: The position of the right edge in the edge-based spelling. The game stores it as a width of Right minus [[Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Left]].
Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Top: The position of the top edge in the edge-based spelling. The Y axis points downward, so Top should not exceed [[Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Bottom]] if the rectangle is to have a positive height.
Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Bottom: The position of the bottom edge in the edge-based spelling. The game stores it as a height of Bottom minus [[Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Top]].
Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Location: The top-left corner, written as a vector such as `[x, y]`, in the corner-plus-size spelling. Must be paired with [[Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Size]], and this spelling is only used when neither the X/Y/Width/Height nor the Left/Right/Top/Bottom keys are complete.
Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Size: The width and height, written as a vector such as `[w, h]`, in the corner-plus-size spelling. Must be paired with [[Halfling.Geometry.Rect.Location]].

Halfling.Geometry.Vector2.0: The X (1st) component when the vector is written in list form `[x, y]`.
Halfling.Geometry.Vector2.1: The Y (2nd) component when the vector is written in list form `[x, y]`.
Halfling.Geometry.Vector2.T:: Stores a 2-dimensional point or displacement in space.
Halfling.Geometry.Vector2.X: The X (1st) component of this Vector2.
Halfling.Geometry.Vector2.Y: The Y (2nd) component of this Vector2.

Halfling.Geometry.Vector3.0: The X (1st) component when the vector is written in list form `[x, y, z]`.
Halfling.Geometry.Vector3.1: The Y (2nd) component when the vector is written in list form `[x, y, z]`.
Halfling.Geometry.Vector3.2: The Z (3rd) component when the vector is written in list form `[x, y, z]`.
Halfling.Geometry.Vector3.T:: Stores a 3-dimensional point or displacement in space.
Halfling.Geometry.Vector3.X: The X (1st) component of this Vector3.
Halfling.Geometry.Vector3.Y: The Y (2nd) component of this Vector3.
Halfling.Geometry.Vector3.Z: The Z (3rd) component of this Vector3.

Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.T:: Stores a series of Sprite frames to be animated in sequence.
Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.AtlasSprite: A sprite whose texture is sliced into animation frames on a grid, as an alternative to listing [[Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.Frames]] individually. When present, [[Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.FrameCount]] and [[Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.FrameSize]] must also be given. The vanilla large cannon bullet slices a 4x4 atlas this way in `shots/bullet_large/bullet_large.rules`.
Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.FrameCount: The number of frames cut from [[Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.AtlasSprite]]. Frames are taken left to right, top to bottom. Required when AtlasSprite is used, ignored otherwise.
Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.FrameSize: The pixel size `[width, height]` of each frame cut from [[Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.AtlasSprite]]. Required when AtlasSprite is used.
Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.FramePadding: The pixel gap `[x, y]` between adjacent frames in the atlas grid. Defaults to no gap.
Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.FramesOffset: The pixel offset of the top-left corner of the first frame within the atlas texture. Defaults to `[0, 0]`.
Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.FramesPerRow: How many frames sit in each row of the atlas grid before slicing wraps to the next row. When omitted all frames are taken from a single row.
Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.Frames: The list of sprites played in sequence, one per frame. Required when [[Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.AtlasSprite]] is not used. At least one frame must be given.
Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.Duration: The total time of one pass through all frames, in seconds. Takes precedence over [[Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.FramesPerSecond]] and [[Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.Interval]]. The per-frame interval becomes Duration divided by the frame count.
Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.FramesPerSecond: The playback rate in frames per second. Used when [[Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.Duration]] is absent.
Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.Interval: The time each frame is displayed, in seconds. Required when neither [[Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.Duration]] nor [[Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.FramesPerSecond]] is given.
Halfling.Graphics.AnimatedSprite.WrapMode: What happens when the animation reaches its end. `Loop` restarts from the beginning, `Clamp` stops on the final frame, `PingPong` reverses direction at either end. Defaults to `Loop`.

Halfling.Graphics.CircleDashInfo.T:: Stores information needed to render a single CircleRenderer "dash".
Halfling.Graphics.CircleDashInfo.SizeWeight: The share of the circle's arc this dash occupies relative to the other dashes in [[Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.Dashes]]. Each repeat of the dash pattern splits its slice of [[Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.Arc]] among the dashes in proportion to their weights. Defaults to 1.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleDashInfo.DashURange: The horizontal texture coordinate range `[from, to]` mapped along the main body of the dash, as 0..1 fractions across the width of the renderer's [[Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.UVRect]]. Defaults to `[0, 1]`. The vanilla ship selection circle in `gui/game/sim_gui.rules` uses ranges like `[32/128, 96/128]` to pick strips of its texture.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleDashInfo.BeginCapLength: The length of the cap rendered at the start of the dash, as a distance along the circumference in the same units as the circle's radius. Added to the result of [[Halfling.Graphics.CircleDashInfo.BeginCapLengthPerThickness]]. When the begin and end caps together would exceed the dash's length they are scaled down proportionally to fit. Defaults to 0.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleDashInfo.BeginCapLengthPerThickness: Extra begin-cap length per unit of the circle's [[Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.Thickness]]. The product is added to [[Halfling.Graphics.CircleDashInfo.BeginCapLength]], so a value of 1 makes the cap as long as the ring is thick. Defaults to 0.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleDashInfo.BeginCapURange: The horizontal texture coordinate range `[from, to]` mapped along the begin cap, as 0..1 fractions across the width of the renderer's [[Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.UVRect]]. Defaults to `[0, 0]`.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleDashInfo.EndCapLength: The length of the cap rendered at the end of the dash, as a distance along the circumference in the same units as the circle's radius. Added to the result of [[Halfling.Graphics.CircleDashInfo.EndCapLengthPerThickness]]. Defaults to 0.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleDashInfo.EndCapLengthPerThickness: Extra end-cap length per unit of the circle's [[Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.Thickness]]. The product is added to [[Halfling.Graphics.CircleDashInfo.EndCapLength]]. Defaults to 0.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleDashInfo.EndCapURange: The horizontal texture coordinate range `[from, to]` mapped along the end cap, as 0..1 fractions across the width of the renderer's [[Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.UVRect]]. Defaults to `[0, 0]`.

Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.T:: Utility class for rendering circles to the screen.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.Dashes: The dash pattern drawn around the circle. Each entry occupies an angular slice proportional to its [[Halfling.Graphics.CircleDashInfo.SizeWeight]], and the whole pattern repeats [[Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.DashRepeat]] plus one times around [[Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.Arc]]. When absent the circle is one unbroken ring. The vanilla ship selection circle in `gui/game/sim_gui.rules` combines this with `DashRepeat` for its segmented look.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.Shader: The Shader used to render the circle. This must be a special shader specifically created for rendering circles.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.ShaderConstants: A collection of constant values for the Shader. This collection may be null if there is no Shader or there are no constants set.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.Texture: The Texture used to render the circle.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.Color: The shader color used to render the circle.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.TargetBlendMode: The TargetBlendMode used to render the circle.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.VertexColor: The vertex colors of both the inner and outer edges of this circle. If getting this property and the inner and outer vertex colors are now equal, an exception will be thrown. Modifying this property will force the underlying circle quads to be recomputed.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.InnerVertexColor: Vertex color of the inner edge of the circle. Modifying this property will force the underlying circle quads to be recomputed.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.UVRect: The UV coordinates on Texture from which the circle is rendered. The outer edge will equal UVRect.Top and the inner edge will equal UVRect.Bottom. The circle will loop from UVRect.Left to UVRect.Right. Modifying this property will force the underlying circle quads to be recomputed.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.InnerRadius: The distance from the center of the circle to inside edge.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.Thickness: The thickness of the circle as measured from its inner radius to its outer radius.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.QuadCount: The number of quads that will be used to form the circle. The higher this value, the smoother the circle will appear. Modifying this property will force the underlying circle quads to be recomputed.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.Arc: The angular arc of the rendered circle. Anything less than 360-degrees will result in a pie-shape. Modifying this property will force the underlying circle quads to be recomputed.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.Z: The Z depth value of the rendered circle. Modifying this property will force the underlying circle quads to be recomputed.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.DashRepeat: The number of times that the dashes will repeat. The default is 0.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.Source: The pixel rectangle `[x, y, width, height]` on [[Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.Texture]] to sample, converted to UV coordinates on load. Only used when [[Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.UVRect]] is not set and a texture is present. When both are absent the whole texture is used.
Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.OuterRadius: The distance from the center of the circle to its outside edge, as an alternative way to size the ring. When given together with [[Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.InnerRadius]] it determines [[Halfling.Graphics.CircleRenderer.Thickness]] as the difference of the two. When given with only Thickness it determines InnerRadius instead.

Halfling.Graphics.Color.0: The red channel on the 0..255 scale when the color is written in list form `[R, G, B]` or `[R, G, B, A]`. A color can also be written as a plain named value such as `White` or `Red`.
Halfling.Graphics.Color.1: The green channel on the 0..255 scale in the list form `[R, G, B]` or `[R, G, B, A]`.
Halfling.Graphics.Color.2: The blue channel on the 0..255 scale in the list form `[R, G, B]` or `[R, G, B, A]`.
Halfling.Graphics.Color.3: The alpha (opacity) channel on the 0..255 scale in the list form `[R, G, B, A]`. When the list has only three entries the color is fully opaque.
Halfling.Graphics.Color.T:: Stores a color as four single-precision floats in RGBA order.
Halfling.Graphics.Color.Rf: The red channel as a 0..1 fraction. Alternative to [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.R]], which uses the 0..255 scale. In group form each of red, green and blue must be given via either its byte-scale or fractional field unless [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.H]], [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.S]] and [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.V]] are all present.
Halfling.Graphics.Color.Gf: The green channel as a 0..1 fraction. Alternative to [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.G]], which uses the 0..255 scale.
Halfling.Graphics.Color.Bf: The blue channel as a 0..1 fraction. Alternative to [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.B]], which uses the 0..255 scale.
Halfling.Graphics.Color.Af: The alpha (opacity) channel as a 0..1 fraction. Alternative to [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.A]], which uses the 0..255 scale. When neither is given the color is fully opaque.
Halfling.Graphics.Color.H: The hue in degrees, 0..360. When [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.H]], [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.S]] and [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.V]] are all present the red, green and blue channels are computed from them and any R/G/B fields are ignored. Opacity still comes from [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.A]] or [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.Af]].
Halfling.Graphics.Color.S: The saturation as a 0..1 fraction of the HSV form. Only used when [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.H]], [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.S]] and [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.V]] are all present.
Halfling.Graphics.Color.V: The brightness value as a 0..1 fraction of the HSV form. Only used when [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.H]], [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.S]] and [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.V]] are all present.
Halfling.Graphics.Color.R: The red channel on the 0..255 scale. The value is divided by 255 on load, so fractions and values above 255 are accepted. [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.Rf]] is the equivalent 0..1 form.
Halfling.Graphics.Color.G: The green channel on the 0..255 scale. The value is divided by 255 on load. [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.Gf]] is the equivalent 0..1 form.
Halfling.Graphics.Color.B: The blue channel on the 0..255 scale. The value is divided by 255 on load. [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.Bf]] is the equivalent 0..1 form.
Halfling.Graphics.Color.A: The alpha (opacity) channel on the 0..255 scale, where 0 is fully transparent and 255 fully opaque. Defaults to fully opaque when neither this nor [[Halfling.Graphics.Color.Af]] is given.

Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.0: The red component, 0..255, when the color is written in list form `[R, G, B]` or `[R, G, B, A]`. A color can also be written as a plain named value such as `White` or `Red`.
Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.1: The green component, 0..255, in the list form `[R, G, B]` or `[R, G, B, A]`.
Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.2: The blue component, 0..255, in the list form `[R, G, B]` or `[R, G, B, A]`.
Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.3: The alpha (opacity) component, 0..255, in the list form `[R, G, B, A]`. When the list has only three entries the color is fully opaque.
Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.T:: Stores a color as an integer with one byte for each of the four channels in BGRA order.
Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.H: The hue in degrees, 0..360. When [[Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.H]], [[Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.S]] and [[Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.V]] are all present the red, green and blue components are computed from them and any R/G/B fields are ignored. Opacity still comes from [[Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.A]] or [[Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.Af]].
Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.S: The saturation as a 0..1 fraction of the HSV form. Only used when [[Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.H]], [[Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.S]] and [[Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.V]] are all present.
Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.V: The brightness value as a 0..1 fraction of the HSV form. Only used when [[Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.H]], [[Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.S]] and [[Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.V]] are all present.
Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.Rf: The red component as a 0..1 fraction, converted to a 0..255 byte on load. Alternative to [[Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.R]]. In group form each of red, green and blue must be given via either its byte or fractional field unless the HSV fields are all present.
Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.Gf: The green component as a 0..1 fraction, converted to a 0..255 byte on load. Alternative to [[Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.G]].
Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.Bf: The blue component as a 0..1 fraction, converted to a 0..255 byte on load. Alternative to [[Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.B]].
Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.Af: The alpha (opacity) component as a 0..1 fraction, converted to a 0..255 byte on load. Alternative to [[Halfling.Graphics.IntColor.A]]. When neither is given the color is fully opaque.

Halfling.Graphics.Material.T:: Stores Texture and other material property values.
Halfling.Graphics.Material.ShaderConstants: A collection of constant values for the Shader. This collection may be null if there is no Shader or there are no constants set.

Halfling.Graphics.Sprite.T:: Extends the Material class to provide color, size, and uv rectangle properties.
Halfling.Graphics.Sprite.VertexColor: The vertex color of the Sprite.
Halfling.Graphics.Sprite.UVRect: The UV rect on Texture of the Sprite.
Halfling.Graphics.Sprite.Source: The pixel rectangle `[x, y, width, height]` on the sprite's texture to sample, converted to UV coordinates on load. Only used when [[Halfling.Graphics.Sprite.UVRect]] is not set and a texture is present. When both are absent the whole texture is used, and the default [[Halfling.Graphics.Sprite.Size]] is derived from the sampled region's pixel size.

Halfling.Graphics.TargetBlendMode.T:: Specifies how pixels in the color buffer are modified as additional pixels are rendered overtop.
Halfling.Graphics.TargetBlendMode.SourceRgbFactor: The SourceRgbFactor parameter for every RGB channel in the equation: RgbOperator([sourceRGB] * SourceRgbFactor, [destRGB] * DestRgbFactor)
Halfling.Graphics.TargetBlendMode.DestRgbFactor: The DestRgbFactor parameter for every RGB channel in the equation: RgbOperator([sourceRGB] * SourceRgbFactor, [destRGB] * DestRgbFactor)
Halfling.Graphics.TargetBlendMode.RgbOperator: The RgbOperator function for every RGB channel in the equation: RgbOperator([sourceRGB] * SourceRgbFactor, [destRGB] * DestRgbFactor)
Halfling.Graphics.TargetBlendMode.SourceAlphaFactor: The SourceAlphaFactor parameter for the alpha channel in the equation: AlphaOperator([sourceAlpha] * SourceAlphaFactor, [destAlpha] * DestAlphaFactor)
Halfling.Graphics.TargetBlendMode.DestAlphaFactor: The DestAlphaFactor parameter for the alpha channel in the equation: AlphaOperator([sourceAlpha] * SourceAlphaFactor, [destAlpha] * DestAlphaFactor)
Halfling.Graphics.TargetBlendMode.AlphaOperator: The AlphaOperator function for the alpha channel in the equation: AlphaOperator([sourceAlpha] * SourceAlphaFactor, [destAlpha] * DestAlphaFactor)

Halfling.Graphics.Text.BlurFontEffect.T:: A font effect that applies a Gaussian blur to a font.

Halfling.Graphics.Text.ColorFontEffect.T:: A simple font effect that changes the color of the font.
Halfling.Graphics.Text.ColorFontEffect.Color: The color that will be applied to the font.

Halfling.Graphics.Text.Font.T:: Generates and stores the texture atlas for a text font.
Halfling.Graphics.Text.Font.File: The font file to load, typically a `.ttf`, resolved relative to this file.
Halfling.Graphics.Text.Font.Files: Several font files loaded together, with later files supplying the glyphs earlier ones lack. Used to chain a fallback font for CJK glyphs.
Halfling.Graphics.Text.Font.Passes: The render passes applied when drawing text, in order. Each pass draws the whole text once with its own offset and [[Halfling.Graphics.Text.FontRenderPass.Effects]], which is how shadow and glow fonts layer a blurred colored copy under the foreground.
Halfling.Graphics.Text.Font.ForceSameWidths: Two equal-length strings read as character pairs: each character in the first string is forced to render with the width of the matching character in the second. Vanilla maps `"123456789"` to `"000000000"` so digits align in columns.
Halfling.Graphics.Text.Font.AntialiasQuality: The antialiasing quality level used when rasterizing glyphs.

Halfling.Graphics.Text.FontRenderPass.T:: Describes a single font rendering pass.
Halfling.Graphics.Text.FontRenderPass.SizeRelativeOffset: The position offset of this pass relative to the pixel size of the font.
Halfling.Graphics.Text.FontRenderPass.Effects: A modifiable list of effects to apply to the font during this render pass. The effects will be applied in the order in which they appear in this list. Adding or removing effects only has an effect on characters that have not yet been pre-rendered.

Halfling.Graphics.Text.IFontEffect.T:: Exoses methods that allow an effect to be applied to a font characters.

Halfling.Graphics.Text.OuterStrokeFontEf.T:: A font effect that applies a "stroke" of color around the edges of the font.
Halfling.Graphics.Text.OuterStrokeFontEf.Color: The color that will be applied to the font's edges.
Halfling.Graphics.Text.OuterStrokeFontEf.RelativeThickness: The thickness of the stroke effect relative to the size of the font. This will be added with AbsoluteThickness.
Halfling.Graphics.Text.OuterStrokeFontEf.AbsoluteThickness: The thickness of the stroke effect in pixels. This will be added with RelativeThickness.
Halfling.Graphics.Text.OuterStrokeFontEf.Falloff: A number that indicates how quickly the stroke effect will disappear as the distance from the edge of the font increases.

Halfling.Gui.Borders.0: The left border size when the value is written in list form. The list order is `[Left, Top, Right, Bottom]` and all four entries are required.
Halfling.Gui.Borders.1: The top border size in the list form `[Left, Top, Right, Bottom]`.
Halfling.Gui.Borders.2: The right border size in the list form `[Left, Top, Right, Bottom]`.
Halfling.Gui.Borders.3: The bottom border size in the list form `[Left, Top, Right, Bottom]`.
Halfling.Gui.Borders.T:: Contains values for the sizes of left, right, top, and bottom borders.
Halfling.Gui.Borders.Left: The size of the border along the left edge, in the pixel units of the rect the borders apply to. Defaults to 0. A Borders value can also be written as a single plain number that sets all four edges, or as the list `[Left, Top, Right, Bottom]`.
Halfling.Gui.Borders.Top: The size of the border along the top edge, in the pixel units of the rect the borders apply to. Defaults to 0.
Halfling.Gui.Borders.Right: The size of the border along the right edge, in the pixel units of the rect the borders apply to. Defaults to 0.
Halfling.Gui.Borders.Bottom: The size of the border along the bottom edge, in the pixel units of the rect the borders apply to. Defaults to 0.

Halfling.Gui.Button.StateNormalTextRenderer: The settings for the text shown when this button is in its "Normal" state.
Halfling.Gui.Button.StateHighlightedTextRenderer: The settings for the text shown when this button is in its "Highlighted" state.
Halfling.Gui.Button.StatePressedTextRenderer: The settings for the text shown when this button is in its "Pressed" or "HotkeyPressed" states.
Halfling.Gui.Button.StateDisabledTextRenderer: The settings for the text shown when this button is in its "Disabled" state.
Halfling.Gui.Button.ClickController: The settings for the component that controls the firing of Clicked events.
Halfling.Gui.Button.ClickAudio: The audio sound effect played when this button is clicked.
Halfling.Gui.Button.Text: The text displayed on this button.
Halfling.Gui.Button.TextProvider: An ITextProvider object that, if not null, will keep this Button's Text property updated to match the ITextProvider.
Halfling.Gui.Button.Hotkey: The IInputButton (or combination of buttons) which will put the widget into a "HotkeyPressed" state.

Halfling.Gui.Components.Animation.Widget.T:: Allows the position, rotation, scale, and color of a Widget to be animated according to some number of weighted animation influencers.

Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetActi.T:: Plays audio effects when the active state of the widget changes.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetActi.ActivatedSound: The sound to play when the widget is activated.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetActi.DeactivatedSound: The sound to play when the widget is deactivated.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetActi.AudioGroup: The AudioGroup in which the sounds will be played. If null, the GuiRoot's DefaultAudioGroup will be used.

Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetFocu.T:: Plays audio effects when the focus state of the widget changes.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetFocu.FocusedSound: The sound to play when the widget becomes focused.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetFocu.DefocusedSound: The sound to play when the widget becomes defocused.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetFocu.AudioGroup: The AudioGroup in which the sounds will be played. If null, the GuiRoot's DefaultAudioGroup will be used.

Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetInpu.T:: Plays audio sound effects when the input state of the widget changes.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetInpu.NormalSound: The sound to play when the input state reverts to its "Normal" state, or null to play no sound.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetInpu.HighlightedSound: The sound to play when the input state switches from "Normal" to "Highlighted", or null to play no sound.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetInpu.PressedSound: The sound to play when the input state switches to "Pressed" or "HotkeyPressed", or null to play no sound.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetInpu.AudioGroup: The AudioGroup in which the sounds will be played. If null, the GuiRoot's DefaultAudioGroup will be used.

Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetSele.T:: Plays audio effects when the selection state of the widget changes.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetSele.SelectedSound: The sound to play when the widget becomes selected.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetSele.DeselectedSound: The sound to play when the widget becomes deselected.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetSele.AudioGroup: The AudioGroup in which the sounds will be played. If null, the GuiRoot's DefaultAudioGroup will be used.

Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetTrig.T:: Plays an audio sound effect when a trigger occurs.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetTrig.Sound: The sound to play when the trigger is triggered.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Audio.WidgetTrig.AudioGroup: The AudioGroup in which the sound will be played. If null, the GuiRoot's DefaultAudioGroup will be used.

Halfling.Gui.Components.AutoSizing.Widge.T:: A widget component that automatically resizes the attached widget according to the desired size of its contents.
Halfling.Gui.Components.AutoSizing.Widge.AutoWidthMode: Whether the width of the widget is automatically sized to match its contents. The desired size of the contents is defined by the DesiredSizeProvider property.
Halfling.Gui.Components.AutoSizing.Widge.AutoHeightMode: Whether the height of the widget is automatically sized to match its contents. The desired size of the contents is defined by the DesiredSizeProvider property.
Halfling.Gui.Components.AutoSizing.Widge.IgnoreForParentAutoSize: Whether the attached widget should be skipped when computing the desired size of its parent widget.
Halfling.Gui.Components.AutoSizing.Widge.WidthPadding: The amount of extra pixels to add when calculating the automatic width of the widget.
Halfling.Gui.Components.AutoSizing.Widge.HeightPadding: The amount of extra pixels to add when calculating the automatic height of the widget.
Halfling.Gui.Components.AutoSizing.Widge.MinWidth: The minimum width to which the widget will be automatically set.
Halfling.Gui.Components.AutoSizing.Widge.MaxWidth: The maximum width to which the widget will be automatically set.
Halfling.Gui.Components.AutoSizing.Widge.WidthValueType: Specifies how the MinWidth and MaxWidth values should be interpreted.
Halfling.Gui.Components.AutoSizing.Widge.MinHeight: The minimum height to which the widget will be automatically set.
Halfling.Gui.Components.AutoSizing.Widge.MaxHeight: The maximum height to which the widget will be automatically set.
Halfling.Gui.Components.AutoSizing.Widge.HeightValueType: Specifies how the MinHeight and MaxHeight values should be interpreted.
Halfling.Gui.Components.AutoSizing.Widge.Anchor: The anchor point around which the widget will be scaled when automatically sizing. The anchor point is a normalized, Widget-relative location with each dimension in the range of [0,1].

Halfling.Gui.Components.Children.WidgetC.T:: Contains a list of child widgets that are contained within the parent widget.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Children.WidgetC.ClipPadding: The distances from the widget's borders outside of which children will not be rendered (assuming ClipChildren is true).
Halfling.Gui.Components.Children.WidgetC.BorderPadding: The distances from the widget's ClipScreenRect that together define the client rectangle in which children are contained. The border padding is cumulative with the clip padding.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Children.WidgetC.CullChildren: Whether all out-of-view children are culled so that they will not be rendered.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Children.WidgetC.ClipChildren: Whether any pixels outside of the ClientScreenRect will be clipped (not rendered).
Halfling.Gui.Components.Children.WidgetC.ChildrenForceParentRendering: Whether any children whose rendering is being forced will also force their parent to render.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Children.WidgetC.ReverseRenderOrder: Whether children will be rendered last-to-first instead of first-to-last.

Halfling.Gui.Components.Droppers.WidgetD.T:: Controls the visibility of another Widget based on the current focus state and position of the attached Widget.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Droppers.WidgetD.AutoParentTargetToRoot: Whether the DropTarget should be automatically parented to the attached Widget's GuiRoot as a drop target.

Halfling.Gui.Components.Droppers.WidgetR.T:: Automatically positions the attached widget relative to the rectangle provided by an IRectProvider.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Droppers.WidgetR.RestrictAutoSizeBounds: Whether the attached widget's auto-size bounds will be automatically restricted to its parent's boundaries.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Droppers.WidgetR.SourceCorner: When AutoPosition is true, gets or sets the corner of the source rect to which the attached widget's TargetCorner will be aligned.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Droppers.WidgetR.TargetCorner: When AutoPosition is true, gets or sets the corner of the attached Widget that will be aligned with the source rect's SourceCorner.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Droppers.WidgetR.PositionOffset: When AutoPosition is true, gets or sets the offset to apply to the position of the attached widget once it is aligned with the source rect.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Droppers.WidgetR.PreferredHorizontalSpace: The amount of horizontal space that is preferred when positioning the attached widget. If the amount of space available is less than this value, then the target may be located on the opposite side of the source rect if there is more space there.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Droppers.WidgetR.PreferredVerticalSpace: The amount of vertical space that is preferred when the positioning the attached widget. If the amount of space available is less than this value, then the target may be located on the opposite side of the source rect if there is more space there.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Droppers.WidgetR.MatchWidth: When AutoPosition is true, gets or sets whether the width of the attached widget will be modified to match the width of the source rect.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Droppers.WidgetR.MatchHeight: When AutoPosition is true, gets or sets whether the height of the attached widget wwill be modified to match the height of the source rect.

Halfling.Gui.Components.Focus.WidgetFocu.T:: Provides a flag indicating whether the attached Widget is focused and methods for requesting and relinquishing focus.

Halfling.Gui.Components.Focus.WidgetMous.T:: Extends the WidgetFocusController class such that the mouse can be used in various ways to focus and defocus the Widget.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Focus.WidgetMous.EnableClickInsideToFocus: Whether clicking the inside of the Widget will cause it to be focused.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Focus.WidgetMous.EnableClickInsideToDefocus: Whether clicking inside of the Widget will cause its focus to be relinquished.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Focus.WidgetMous.EnableClickOutsideToDefocus: Whether clicking outside of the Widget will cause its focus to be relinquished.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Focus.WidgetMous.EnableMouseEnterToFocus: Whether moving the mouse inside the Widget will cause it to be focused.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Focus.WidgetMous.EnableMouseLeaveToDefocus: Whether moving the mouse outside of the Widget will cause its focus to be relinquished.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Focus.WidgetMous.EnableChainedWidgetChecking: When EnableClickOutsideToDefocus is true or EnableMouseLeaveToDefocus is true, gets or sets whether clicking on or mousing-over another Widget chained to the attached Widget will prevent the attached Widget from defocusing.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Focus.WidgetMous.MouseButton: The IInputButton that can be used to focus and defocus the Widget.

Halfling.Gui.Components.Graphics.GuiSpri.T:: A sprite displayed by a GUI widget.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Graphics.GuiSpri.ShaderConstants: A collection of constant values for the Shader. This collection may be null if there is no Shader or there are no constants set.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Graphics.GuiSpri.VertexColor: The vertex color of the sprite.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Graphics.GuiSpri.UVRect: The UV coordinates on Texture of the sprite.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Graphics.GuiSpri.Bleed: The amount by which the sprite will extend passed its rect.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Graphics.GuiSpri.Source: The pixel rectangle `[x, y, width, height]` on [[Halfling.Gui.Components.Graphics.GuiSprite.Texture]] to display, converted to UV coordinates on load. Only used when [[Halfling.Gui.Components.Graphics.GuiSprite.UVRect]] is not set and a texture is present. When both are absent the whole texture is shown.

Halfling.Gui.Components.Graphics.WidgetN.T:: A widget component that renders a nine-sliced sprite to the screen.
Halfling.Gui.Components.Graphics.WidgetN.Borders: The sizes of each of the border tiles of this nine-slice.

Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleLerp.FromValue: The value written when the [[Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleLerp.LerpIn]] T value is 0, or when it is 1 if [[Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleLerp.Invert]] is set. The interpolation is not clamped, so T values outside 0..1 extrapolate past the endpoints.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleLerp.ToValue: The value written when the [[Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleLerp.LerpIn]] T value is 1, or when it is 0 if [[Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleLerp.Invert]] is set. The vanilla radiator's hit_sparks effect lerps each spark's `velocity` from (1, 1) down to a ToValue of (0, 0) over its life.

Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleLife.T:: Counts every particle down over the same fixed `Lifetime` and deletes it at the end. Other updaters read that same countdown to fade size and color.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleLife.LifeInOut: The data that stores the particle's energy. This data should be initialized to 1.0.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleLife.Lifetime: The lifetime of a single particle.

Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleOper.T:: Combines two particle variables with `Operator` and writes the result into a third.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleOper.DataType: The type of data being operated on.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleOper.AIn: The data that will be used as the "A" (left-hand) operand.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleOper.BIn: The data that will be used as the "B" (right-hand) operand. This data will not be modified.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleOper.ResultOut: The data that will be set to the result of the operation.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleOper.Operator: The mathematical operator used on DataAInOut and DataBIn.

Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleOper.T:: Applies `Operator` between a particle variable and a constant `Value`, such as multiplying every particle's scale by a fixed amount.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleOper.AIn: The data that will be used as the "A" (left-hand) operand.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleOper.ResultOut: The data that will be set to the result of the operation.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleOper.Operator: The mathematical operator used on DataAInOut and DataBIn.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleOper.ValueType: The type of the constant operand, which also selects the type used to read [[Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleOperatorConst.AIn]] and write [[Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleOperatorConst.ResultOut]]. One of `Float`, `Angle`, `Vector2`, `Vector3`, `Vector4`, `Color`, `Int`, `IntVector2`, `IntVector3` or `IntVector4`. `Angle` behaves identically to `Float`.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleOper.Value: The constant used as the "B" (right-hand) operand of [[Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleOperatorConst.Operator]], in the type selected by [[Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleOperatorConst.ValueType]]. The vanilla radiator's hit_sparks effect multiplies its hit normal by a Value of (-0.5, -0.5) to compute a hit offset.

Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticlePerp.T:: Writes the vector at right angles to an input vector, for spray thrown out sideways from a direction of travel.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticlePerp.VectorIn: The Vector2 data channel read as the input vector. Defaults to the channel named `vector_in`.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticlePerp.VectorOut: The Vector2 data channel that receives the input rotated 90 degrees, computed as (-Y, X). Defaults to the channel named `perpendicular`. The vanilla radiator's hit_sparks effect uses this to offset sparks sideways along the hit surface.

Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleRota.T:: Turns a vector by a random angle within `Rotation`, to scatter a direction that would otherwise be identical for every particle.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleRota.VectorIn: The Vector2 data channel read as the vector to rotate. Defaults to the channel named `vector_in`.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleRota.VectorOut: The Vector2 data channel that receives the rotated result. May name the same channel as [[Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleRotateVectorRandom.VectorIn]] to rotate in place. Defaults to the channel named `rotated_vector`.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleRota.Rotation: The rotation range in degrees. Each particle is rotated by an independent random angle drawn uniformly between Min and Max, inclusive. The vanilla radiator's hit_sparks effect uses -60d to 60d to vary each spark's hit-normal direction.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleRota.Origin: The pivot point the input vector is rotated around. Defaults to (0, 0), which rotates the vector about the coordinate origin.

Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleScal.T:: Applies `Operator` between a single float variable and a wider one such as a Vector2 or a Color, hitting every component at once.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleScal.AIn: The data that will be used as the "A" (left-hand) operand.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleScal.DataType: The type of data being operated on.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleScal.BIn: The data that will be used as the "B" (right-hand) operand. This data will not be modified.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleScal.ResultOut: The data that will be set to the result of the operation.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleScal.Operator: The mathematical operator used on DataAInOut and DataBIn.

Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.T:: Sets a particle variable to a random value between `FromValue` and `ToValue`, the usual way to vary size, rotation or tint across a burst.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.DataOut: The data that will received the lerped values.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.ValueType: The type of value to randomize and of the [[Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetRandom.DataOut]] channel. One of `Float`, `Angle`, `Vector2`, `Vector3`, `Vector4`, `Color`, `Int`, `IntVector2`, `IntVector3` or `IntVector4`. `Angle` behaves identically to `Float`.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.FromValue: The lower bound of the random range, in the type selected by [[Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetRandom.ValueType]]. Each particle receives an independent uniform random value between this and [[Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetRandom.ToValue]], inclusive. For vector and color types every component is drawn independently.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.ToValue: The upper bound of the random range, in the type selected by [[Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetRandom.ValueType]]. The vanilla radiator's hit_sparks effect randomizes `base_scale` between a FromValue of 0.5 and a ToValue of 2 and picks each spark's `base_color` between two Color bounds.

Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.T:: Scatters new particles at random inside `Circle`, or around its rim when `Perimeter` is set.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.LocationOut: The data that stores the particle velocities. This data will be modified.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.Circle: The circle in which particles locations will be randomly chosen.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.Perimeter: Whether locations will be chosen on the circle's perimeter instead of inside it.

Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.T:: Tints each new particle a random color drawn from hue, saturation, value and alpha ranges.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.ColorOut: The data that will store the particle colors.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.HueRange: The possible range of color hues.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.SaturationRange: The possible range of color saturations.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.ValueRange: The possible range of color values.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.AlphaRange: The possible range of color alpha values.

Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.T:: Launches each new particle at a random `Speed` in a random `Direction`.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.VelocityOut: The data that stores the particle velocities. This data will be modified.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.Speed: The initial speed of particles as a random range.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.Direction: The initial direction of the particles as a random arc.

Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.T:: Launches each new particle straight away from `AwayFromPoint` at a random `Speed`, for outward bursts and shockwaves.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.LocationIn: The data that stores the particle locations.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.VelocityOut: The data that stores the particle velocities. This data will be modified.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.Speed: The initial speed of particles as a random range.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.AwayFromPoint: The point away from which particles will fly.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetR.ConvertPointToWorldSpace: Whether the AwayFromPoint should be converted to world-space before the velocity is calculated.

Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetV.T:: Sets a particle variable to a fixed `Value`, the plainest way to give every particle the same starting size, tint or offset.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetV.DataOut: The data that will be initialized to the value.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetV.ValueType: The type of the constant and of the [[Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetValue.DataOut]] channel. One of `Float`, `Angle`, `Vector2`, `Vector3`, `Vector4`, `Color`, `Int`, `IntVector2`, `IntVector3` or `IntVector4`. `Angle` behaves identically to `Float`.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetV.Value: The constant written to [[Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetValue.DataOut]] for every particle each time the updater runs, in the type selected by [[Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleSetValue.ValueType]].

Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleUvAn.T:: Plays a sprite sheet as a flipbook on each particle, stepping frames at `Framerate` as the particle ages.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleUvAn.TimeIn: The data that stores the particle's elapsed time.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleUvAn.UvRectOut: The data that stores the particle's UV rect coordinates.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleUvAn.Framerate: The number of frames displayed every second.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleUvAn.TextureSize: The size of the texture containing the frames of animation.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleUvAn.FrameSize: The size of an individual sprite frame in the texture.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleUvAn.FrameCount: The number of sprite frames in the animation.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleUvAn.FramesPerRow: The number of sprite frames in a single row in the texture.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleUvAn.PixelOffset: The offset in pixels of the animation frames in the texture.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleUvAn.Looping: Whether the animation should loop after reaching the end. If false, the last frame of animation will be held.

Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleUvSp.T:: Picks one frame of a sprite sheet per particle from `SpriteIndexIn`, so a single burst can mix several shapes.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleUvSp.SpriteIndexIn: The data that stores the particle's sprite index.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleUvSp.UvRectOut: The data that stores the particle's UV rect coordinates.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleUvSp.TextureSize: The size of the texture containing the sprites.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleUvSp.SpriteSize: The size of an individual sprite in the texture.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleUvSp.SpriteCount: The number of sprites in the animation.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleUvSp.SpritesPerRow: The number of sprites in a single row in the texture.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleUvSp.PixelOffset: The offset in pixels of the sprites in the texture.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleUvSp.Looping: Whether the index should loop after reaching the end. If false, the index will be clamped by the sprite count.

Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleValu.T:: Drives a particle variable along a curve of `Points` as `LerpIn` runs from 0 to 1, for fades that are not a straight line.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleValu.LerpIn: The data that stores the T values used for the lerp.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleValu.CurveOut: The data that will received the lerped colors.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleValu.Invert: Whether the LerpIn value should be inverted.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleValu.Points: The array of points from which the output value will be interpolated.

Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleVari.T:: Counts each particle down over its own lifetime read from `LifetimeIn` and deletes it at the end, so particles in one burst can die at different times.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleVari.LifeInOut: The data that stores the particle's energy. This data should be initialized to 1.0.
Halfling.Particles.Updaters.ParticleVari.LifetimeIn: The data that stores the particle's full lifetime.

Halfling.Physics2D.Dynamics.Drag.Exponen.T:: Angular drag of the form `-Coefficient * speed^Exponent`, so a fast spin is slowed far harder than a slow one.
Halfling.Physics2D.Dynamics.Drag.Exponen.MinDampingCoefficient: The minimum amount of damping applied as a factor of the relative velocity.

Halfling.Physics2D.Dynamics.Drag.Exponen.T:: Linear drag of the form `-Coefficient * speed^Exponent`, so a fast body is slowed far harder than a slow one.
Halfling.Physics2D.Dynamics.Drag.Exponen.MinDampingCoefficient: The minimum amount of damping applied as a factor of the relative velocity.

Halfling.Physics2D.Dynamics.Drag.IAngula.T:: Stores data for and creates IAngularDragSolver instances.

Halfling.Physics2D.Dynamics.Drag.ILinear.T:: Stores data for and creates ILinearDragSolver instances.

Halfling.Physics2D.Dynamics.Drag.Viscous.T:: Angular drag proportional to spin speed, `-Coefficient * speed`.
Linear drag proportional to speed, `-Coefficient * speed`.

Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleDirec.T:: Rotates a direction vector out of world space into the effect's own coordinates.
Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleDirec.DirectionIn: The Vector2 data channel holding a world-space direction vector. Defaults to the channel named `direction_world`. Only the first particle of each update batch is actually sampled, so the input is assumed to be the same for all particles.
Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleDirec.DirectionOut: The Vector2 data channel that receives the direction converted into the emitting scene node's local space, ignoring translation. Defaults to the channel named `direction_local`. The vanilla radiator's hit_sparks effect converts the `hit_normal` from a GetHitNormal initializer into local space this way.

Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleLocat.T:: Converts a particle's location out of the effect's local coordinates into world coordinates, so it stops following the ship that spawned it.
Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleLocat.LocationIn: The data that stores the location that should be converted to world space.
Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleLocat.LocationOut: The data that stores the converted location.

Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleRotat.T:: Converts a particle's rotation out of the effect's local coordinates into world coordinates, so it no longer turns with the ship.
Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleRotat.RotationIn: The data that stores the rotation that should be converted to world space.
Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleRotat.RotationOut: The data that stores the converted rotation.

Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleScale.T:: Converts a particle's scale out of the effect's local coordinates into world scale.
Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleScale.ScaleIn: The data that stores the location that should be converted to world space.
Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleScale.ScaleOut: The data that stores the converted location.

Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleSetWo.T:: Places each new particle at `LocalLocation` measured against the effect, and stores the world position that lands on.
Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleSetWo.LocationOut: The data that stores the converted location.
Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleSetWo.LocalLocation: The local location that will be converted to a world location.

Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleSetWo.T:: Sets each new particle's world rotation from `LocalRotation` measured against the effect's own facing.
Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleSetWo.RotationOut: The data that stores the converted rotation.
Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleSetWo.LocalRotation: The local rotation that will be converted to a world rotation.

Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleSetWo.T:: Sets each new particle's world scale from `LocalScale` measured against the effect's own scale.
Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleSetWo.ScaleOut: The data that stores the converted location.
Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleSetWo.LocalScale: The the local scale that will be converted to a world scale.

Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleSetWo.T:: Sets each new particle's world velocity from `LocalVelocity` measured against the effect's own facing.
Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleSetWo.VelocityOut: The data that stores the converted velocity.
Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleSetWo.LocalVelocity: The local velocity that will be converted to a world velocity.

Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleVeloc.T:: Converts a particle's velocity out of the effect's local coordinates into world coordinates.
Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleVeloc.VelocityIn: The data that stores the velocity that should be converted to world space.
Halfling.Scene2D.Particles.ParticleVeloc.VelocityOut: The data that stores the converted velocity.

Halfling.Timing.Time.T:: Stores a time value in fractions of a second. Interchangeable with System.TimeSpan, System.Single, and System.Double. Internal tracks time as a double-precision float of seconds.
Halfling.Timing.Time._seconds: The time span in seconds. A Time value is normally written directly as a plain number thanks to its empty serialization alias, so a `_seconds` key never actually appears in rules files. Values containing colons are also accepted as clock strings, where `1:30` means 1 minute 30 seconds and `1:00:00` means 1 hour.

Halfling.Windows.Cursor.T:: Stores the data for a single hardware-rendered cursor.
Halfling.Windows.Cursor.File: The cursor bitmap, resolved relative to this file. Either this or [[Halfling.Windows.Cursor.OSCursor]] must be present.
Halfling.Windows.Cursor.HotSpot: The pixel inside the bitmap that sits on the exact mouse position, as `[x, y]` from the top-left. Defaults to the top-left corner.
Halfling.Windows.Cursor.Scale: A factor the cursor bitmap is scaled by when displayed.
Halfling.Windows.Cursor.OSCursor: A cursor supplied by the operating system instead of a bitmap, named by its standard role.
